Friends
1007 - The One With The Home Study

Written by: Mark Kunerth
Produced by: Robert Carlock and Wendy Knoller
Transcribed by: Coffee Mug, Eleonora, Sebastiano & Vanessa
Final check by Kim

[Scene: Central Perk]

(Joey and Ross enter. Phoebe and Mike are sitting on the couch, reading a magazine.)

Ross: Hey you guys!
嘿你们！

Phoebe: Hey!
嘿！

Ross: Hey, what are you doing?
嘿，你在做什么？

Mike: Oh, figuring out our wedding plans.
哦，正在制定我们的婚礼计划。

Chandler: That's funny, we were doing the same thing!
真有趣，我们在做同样的事情！

Ross: Yeah!
是的！

Phoebe: It's really crazy!
真是太疯狂了！ The hall, the dress, the food...
场地、婚纱、宴席…… I-I had no idea how expensive this stuff was!
我、我不知道这东西有多贵！

Chandler: Yeah it is really pricey.
是的，它确实很贵。 I mean, I freaked when I first heard the numbers.
我的意思是，当我第一次听到这些数字时我吓坏了。

Phoebe: So what did you two do about it?
那么你们两个对此做了什么？

Chandler: It was pretty simple actually, I came up with a couple of cost-cutting solutions, wrote out a list and Monica told me to go to hell.
实际上这很简单，我想出了几个削减成本的解决方案，写了一个清单，莫妮卡告诉我见鬼去吧。

Ross: There's no way around it Pheebs, you just gonna have to accept the fact that this is gonna cost you a lot of money.
没有办法解决这个问题，菲比，你只能接受这样一个事实：这会花费你很多钱。

Mike: I heard that weddings are like a 40 billion dollar a year industry.
我听说婚礼就像一个每年400亿美元的产业。

Ross: Yeah, and I'm responsible for just like half of that.
对，我就贡献了其中差不多一半。

Phoebe: But really, it does seem like this money could be put to better use?
但说实话，这笔钱似乎确实可以得到更好的利用？

Mike: Are you serious?
你是认真的？

Phoebe: Yeah!
是的！ Now, how would you feel if we gave all the wedding money to charity and we just got married at City Hall?
现在，如果我们把所有的婚礼费用都捐给慈善机构并且我们刚刚在市政厅结婚，你会有什么感觉？

Mike: I think it would make me wanna marry you even more.
那样我只会更想娶你。 (he kisses her)

Ross: I've got to say you guys, that's an incredible gesture!
我不得不说你们，这是一个令人难以置信的举动！

Chandler: (to Ross) Maybe you do that next time you get married!
（对罗斯）也许你下次结婚的时候就这样做！

Ross: No, no, no. The next time it's gonna be a Hawaii at sunset.
不，不，不。下次将会是日落时分的夏威夷。 [pause] But maybe the time after that!
（停顿）不过再下一次也许可以！


Opening Credits

[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment]

(Monica is cleaning the table, Chandler is sitting on the sofa. Joey enters.)

Joey: Hey!
嘿！

Chandler: Hey!
嘿！

Joey: What's going on?
这是怎么回事？

Chandler: Our adoption social worker is coming by today so we are cleaning the apartment.
我们的收养社工今天来了，所以我们正在打扫公寓。

Monica: (sarcastically) We?
（讽刺地）我们？

Chandler: You know you don't want me to help.
你知道你不想让我帮忙。 You can't have it both ways!
你不能两全其美！

Joey: Hey, is this person who decides whether or not you...
嘿，就是这个人决定你是否... get a baby?
能不能领养到孩子的人？

Chandler: Kind of.
有点儿。 She's coming by to interview us and see where we live.
她要过来采访我们并看看我们住在哪里。

Monica: And it has to go perfectly, because if she doesn't like something about us she can keep us off every adoption list in the state.
而且必须一切顺利，因为如果她不喜欢我们的某些方面，她可以将我们排除在该州的所有收养名单之外。

Joey: Hey, maybe I should stop by!
嘿，也许我应该顺便过来一下！ She could be a soap opera fan!
她可能是肥皂剧迷！ It's very impressive when the little people know a celebrity.
当小人物认识名人时，这是非常令人印象深刻的。

Chandler: (pointing at himself) Little people?
（指着自己）小人物？

Joey: (pointing at himself) Celebrity.
（指着自己）名人。

Monica: Ok, so I think I'm just about done here, unless you have any bad stuff hidden somewhere, like...
好吧，所以我想我已经完成了，除非你有任何不好的东西隐藏在某处，比如...... porn or cigarettes?
色情片还是香烟？

Chandler: What...?
什么...？ NO!
不！

Monica: Chandler?
钱德勒？

Chandler: (he stands up and he feels very offended) I don't, and I'm offended by the insinuation!
（他站起来，他感到非常被冒犯）我不，而且我被这种暗示所冒犯了！

Monica: Ok, so there's not a magazine under the couch, or a pack of cigarettes taped to the back of the toilet tank, or a filthy video in the VCR?
好吧，沙发底下没有杂志，马桶水箱后面贴着一包香烟，录像机里没有肮脏的视频？

Chandler: I'll admit to the cigarettes and the magazine, but that tape is not mine.
我承认有香烟和杂志，但那盘磁带不是我的。

Monica: It isn't mine!
这不是我的！

Joey: (going out with the VCR in his hand) Well, I guess we'll never know whose it is!
（手里拿着录像机走出去）好吧，我想我们永远不会知道它是谁的！

 

[Scene: The New York City Children's fund hallway.]

Charity guy: May I help you?
我可以帮你吗？

Phoebe: Yes.
是的。 We're here to make a rather sizeable donation to the children.
我们来这里是为了给孩子们提供相当大的捐款。

Charity guy: Well, any contribution, large or small, is always appreciated.
好吧，任何贡献，无论大小，总是受到赞赏。

Phoebe: Well, I think you're gonna appreciate it the crap out of this one (she gives him a check)
那这一笔绝对能把你感激坏了。（递支票）

Charity guy: Well, this is very generous!
嗯，这真是太慷慨了！

Phoebe: And we don't want any recognition.
我们不想要任何认可。 This is completely anonymous.
这是完全匿名的。

Mike: Completely anonymous.
完全匿名。 From two kind strangers.
来自两个善良的陌生人。

Phoebe: Mr. X and Phoebe Buffay.
X先生和菲比布菲。

Charity guy: Well if you like, we can include your names in our newsletter.
如果您愿意，我们可以将您的名字包含在我们的时事通讯中。

Mike: Not necessary.
没有必要。

Phoebe: Buffay is spelled B-U-F-F-A-Y.
布菲的拼写是 B-U-F-F-A-Y。

Mike: And "X" is spelled uhm...
“X”的拼写是嗯...... "Mike Hannigan".
“迈克·汉尼根”。

Charity guy: Right.
正确的。 Well, on behalf of the children: thank you both very much.
好吧，我代表孩子们：非常感谢你们俩。

Phoebe: Sure, I so glad we did this.
当然，我很高兴我们这么做了。 It feels so good!
感觉真好！

Mike: It does.
确实如此。 It feels really good!
感觉真的很好！

Phoebe: Oh, look!
哦，看！ And we get these free t-shirts!
我们还获得这些免费 T 恤！ (she takes a t-shirt which was on the counter)

Charity guy: Oh, actually, that's the shirt I wore to the gym.
哦，实际上，那是我去健身房穿的衬衫。

Phoebe: Mhm...
嗯... it's moist.
它很潮湿。

 

[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment.]

Ross: (he enters) Hi!
（他进来）嗨！

Rachel: Hi!
你好！ Emma will be up in a minute!
艾玛一会儿就起来！

Ross: Oh, good!
噢，很好！

Rachel: Oh hey Ross...
哦嘿罗斯... Listen, I heard about you and Charlie.
听着，我听说过你和查理的事。 I'm really sorry.
我真的很抱歉。

Ross: Oh, that's OK.
哦，没关系。 I'm sure there are tons of other beautiful paleontologists out there.
我确信还有很多其他美丽的古生物学家。

Rachel: Absolutely.
绝对地。

Ross: There was one!
有一个！ She's it!
就是她了！ All the rest look like they should live under a bridge!
其余的人看起来都应该住在桥下！

Rachel: So, uhm...
所以，嗯... what are you gonna do today?
你今天要做什么？

Ross: Well, I was thinking of taking Emma to the playground!
好吧，我想带艾玛去游乐场！

Rachel: Oh my God, what!?
天哪，什么！？

Ross: Like I said I was thinking of taking Emma to the museum of knives and fire!
就像我说的，我正在考虑带艾玛去刀与火博物馆！

Rachel: Ok, look, Ross.
好吧，看，罗斯。 I do not want Emma going to the playground.
我不想让艾玛去游乐场。

Ross: Be-caaauuuse...
因为...

Rachel: (upset) All right, well, if you must know...
（不安）好吧，好吧，如果你一定要知道的话…… I had a traumatic...
我曾经历过一次创伤... swing incident...
荡秋千的事故…… when I was little.
当我小的时候。

Ross: Seriously?
严重地？

Rachel: Yes, I was 4 years old and I was on the swing and then all of a sudden my hair got tangled in the chain.
是的，当时我 4 岁，我正在荡秋千，然后突然我的头发被链子缠住了。 And to get me out my mom had to-had to cut a big chunk of my hair!
为了让我出去，我妈妈不得不——不得不剪掉我的一大块头发！ (crying) And it was uneven for weeks!
（哭）之后好几个星期，头发都参差不齐！

Ross: (sarcastic) And you made it through that?
（讽刺地）这么大的打击，你居然挺过来了？ I wonder who's gonna play you in the movie!
我想知道谁会在电影中扮演你！

Rachel: Ok, fine!
好吧，好吧！ You can make fun of me.
你可以取笑我。 I do not want Emma going there.
我不想让艾玛去那里。 And I was thinking Claire Danes.
我想到了克莱尔·丹尼斯。

Ross: Look, I'm sorry to hear about your tragedy, ok?
听着，听到你的悲剧我很难过，好吗？ But the swings are perfectly safe, and besides Emma loves them.
但秋千非常安全，而且艾玛很喜欢它们。 You know what, you should come with us and you'll see!
你知道吗，你应该和我们一起去，你就会看到！

Rachel: Ross, those things go like 40 miles an hour!
罗斯，这些东西的时速大约是 40 英里！ Ok?
好的？ When you're...
当你... and there is that moment when you are at the top, when you just don't know if you're gonna return back to earth!
总有那么一刻，当你站在巅峰时，你不知道自己是否会回到地球！

Ross: Space is filled with orbiting children.
太空中充满了绕轨道运行的儿童。 (pause) Look, please, just come on, you know, when you’ll see the look on Emma’s face, I swear you won’t regret it.
（停顿）听着，拜托，来吧，你知道，当你看到艾玛脸上的表情时，我发誓你不会后悔的。

Rachel: All right!
好的！

Ross: Good, you don’t want to be one of those mothers who pass on their irrational fears on their children, do you?
很好，您不想成为那些将非理性恐惧传递给孩子的母亲之一，是吗？

Rachel: Irrational, huh?
不合理吧？ All right, well, I’ll remember that the next time you freak out about a spider in your apartment!
好吧，好吧，下次当你对公寓里的蜘蛛感到害怕时，我会记住这一点！

Ross: Oh, yeah, that’s the same, I am sure there are thirty different species of poisonous swings!
哦，对了，是一样的，毒秋千肯定有三十种之多！

[Scene: Monica’s apartment. Somebody knocks the door]

Monica: Oh my God, the adoption lady is early!
天哪，收养女士来得好早啊！

Chandler: Ok, ok, here we go.
好吧，好吧，我们开始吧。

Monica: Ok.
好的。

Chandler: Here we go.
开始了。 Stand up straight.
站直。 (smiling) Big smile.
（微笑）灿烂的笑容。 (opens the door and both are smiling exaggeratedly)

Phoebe: Hello, is this the creepy residence?
你好，这是令人毛骨悚然的住所吗？

Monica: We’re waiting for the adoption lady, but, hey, I’m glad you’re here.
我们正在等待收养女士，但是，嘿，我很高兴你在这里。 I was cleaning this morning and I found this (she puts a box on the table and opens it).
今天早上我在打扫卫生时发现了这个（她把一个盒子放在桌子上并打开它）。 I don’t know if you wanna use it, but…
我不知道你是否想用它，但是……

Phoebe: Awe, this is so sweet of you!
哇，你真是太贴心了！ But you know what?
但你知道吗？ I won’t be needing a veil, I actually won’t be wearing a dress at all!
我不需要面纱，实际上我根本不会穿裙子！

Monica: I told you!
我告诉你了！ I am not coming to a naked wedding!
我不会参加裸体婚礼！

Phoebe: No, no, no, we’re not having a big reception, we took the money we were gonna spend on a wedding and we donate them to the children charity.
不，不，不，我们没有举办盛大的招待会，我们把婚礼上花的钱捐给了儿童慈善机构。

Monica: That’s crazy!
太疯狂了！ (Phoebe looks bewildered).
（菲比看起来很困惑）。 I am sorry.
对不起。 I just can’t imagine giving up my one wedding day like that!
我简直无法想象就这样放弃我的婚礼！

Phoebe: We, you know, we’re different!
我们，你知道，我们不一样！ We don’t care about having a huge party.
我们不在乎举办一个盛大的聚会。 (She picks up the veil) This is really nice for you, but, oh, please, I put this on?
（拿起头纱）你戴着确实好看，可换成我？拜托。 (she puts it on) And, ow, I look (she looks her reflex image on a toaster), why, well, radiant.
（她戴上它）然后，哦，我看（她看着烤面包机上的反射图像），为什么，嗯，容光焕发。 (pause) All right, well, who cares, I don’t need a pretty veil and a fancy dress.
（停顿）好吧，好吧，谁在乎呢，我不需要漂亮的面纱和漂亮的裙子。

Monica: That’s right.
这是正确的。 You’re making a commitment and that’s the same, whether you do that at the Plaza or, where are you gonna do it?
你们是在许下一生的承诺，不管在广场酒店，还是——你们打算在哪儿办来着？

Phoebe: City Hall.
市政府。

Monica: Ow!
噢！ (Chandler slaps her on her back) Oh, that sounds nice!
（钱德勒拍拍她的背）哦，听起来不错！ I am just there for jury duty.
我只是来履行陪审员职责的。 They really spruce that place up!
他们真的把那个地方打扮得漂漂亮亮的！

Phoebe: It’s ok, it’s ok.
没关系，没关系。 I made my decision.
我做出了决定。 What I really want is a great big wedding (she covers her mouth)
我真正想要的是一场盛大的婚礼（她捂住了嘴）

Monica: Yay!
耶！

Chandler: But you already gave all your money to charity!
但你已经把所有的钱都捐给了慈善机构！

Phoebe: Well, I’ll just ask for it back!
好吧，我就索要回来！

Chandler: I don’t think you can do that!
我认为你做不到！

Monica: Why not!
为什么不呢！ This is her wedding day, this is way more important than some stupid kids!
今天是她的大婚之日，这比一些傻孩子重要多了！

Chandler: That’s sweet, honey, but save something for the adoption Lady.
说得真贴心，亲爱的，不过这种话留几句说给领养社工听吧。

[Scene: The playground. Ross put Emma on the swing and they’re ready to play]

Rachel: Ok, careful.
好的，小心点。

Ross: Ok.
好的。

Rachel: Careful, watch her hair.
小心，注意她的头发。 WATCH HER HAIR!
注意她的头发！

Ross: Rach, she’s got like three hairs!
瑞秋，她有三根头发！

Rachel: I know (she touches Emma’s head) but they’re just so beautiful!
我知道（她摸着艾玛的头）但它们实在是太漂亮了！ Oh, my God, I just pulled one out.
天哪，我刚刚拔出了一根。

Ross: I promise you she’s safe!
我向你保证她很安全！ No watch how much she loves this.
现在看看她有多喜欢荡秋千吧。

Rachel: Ok.
好的。

Ross (to Emma): Ready sweety?
准备好了吗亲爱的？

Rachel: Ok.
好的。

Ross: Here we go!
开始了！ (He starts pushing Emma)

Rachel: Ok, careful, ok.
好吧，小心一点，好吧。 (Emma giggles) Oh, she’s smiling!
（艾玛咯咯笑）哦，她在微笑！ Oh my God, she does like it!
天哪，她真的很喜欢！

Ross: See, I told you!
看，我告诉过你了！

Rachel: Awe!
哎呀，好可爱！ (Emma laughs) Oh my God!
（艾玛笑）天啊！ Looks, she’s a little dare-devil!
看来，她还真是​​有点胆大包天啊！ Oh, let me push, can I push?
哦，让我推一下，我可以推吗？

Ross: Oh, absolutely!
哦，绝对！

Rachel: Ok.
好的。 Oh God.
天啊。 (To Ross) Get the camera, it’s in the diaper bag.
（对罗斯）拿起相机，它在尿布袋里。

Ross: Ok!
好的！ (he takes the camera and walks backwards to take a shot) See?
（他拿起相机，向后走去拍照）看到了吗？ Scared of swings, I bet you feel pretty silly (a swinging boy knocks him down) Ow!
害怕秋千，我敢打赌你会觉得很傻（一个秋千男孩把他撞倒了）哦！

 

[Scene: The New York City Children's fund ]

Mike: We’re seriously asking for our money back?
我们真的在要求退款吗？

Phoebe: It’s for our wedding day!
这是为了我们的婚礼！ Right, now, is this guy gay or straight, because one of us gonna have to start flirting.
现在，这个人是同性恋还是异性恋，因为我们中的一个人必须开始调情。

Charity guy: Wow!
哇！ Are you here to make another donation the same day?
您当天是否要再次捐款？ I don’t think that that’s ever happened before.
我认为以前从未发生过这种情况。

Phoebe (to Mike): Gay, go.
同性恋，你上。

Mike (to the charity guy): Oh my God, I love your shirt!
天哪，我喜欢你的衬衫！

Phoebe: The donation we made earlier, we k…, we w…, we want it back.
我们之前所做的捐赠，我们知道……，我们……，我们想要回来。

Charity guy: Excuse me?
打扰一下？

Phoebe: Yeah.
是的。 See, that money was for a big wedding, that we thought we didn’t want, but it turns out we do.
看，这笔钱是用来举办一场盛大的婚礼的，我们以为我们不想要，但事实证明我们想要。

Charity guy: So you’re asking us to refund your donation to the children?
所以你要求我们退还你给孩子们的捐款？

Mike: Yeah!
是的！ This feels really good.
这感觉真好。

Phoebe: I am sorry.
对不起。 I am, but this wedding is just really important to me.
我是，但这场婚礼对我来说真的很重要。

Charity guy: Hey, it’s not my business, (he takes their check from a drawer) besides it’s probably a good thing.
嘿，这不关我的事，（他从抽屉里拿出支票）此外，这可能是一件好事。 We really would have been spoiling the children, all those food, and warm clothing…
我们真的会宠坏孩子们、所有这些食物和保暖的衣服……

Phoebe: Hey, that’s not fair!
嘿，这不公平！ A person’s wedding is important!
一个人的婚礼很重要！ And especially to me!
尤其是对我来说！ Ok?
好的？ I didn’t have a graduation party!
我没有举办毕业派对！ And I didn’t go to Prom.
我没有去参加舞会。 And I spent my sweet sixteen being chased round a tire yard by an escaped mental patient who is his own words wanted to “kill me” or whatever.
我十六岁生日那天，被一个从精神病院逃出来的人在旧轮胎场追着跑。他原话说，要“杀了我”什么的。 So I deserve a real celebration and I am not gonna let some sweaty little man make me feel badly about it.( She storms out)
所以我应该得到一个真正的庆祝，我不会让一个满头大汗的小男人让我感到难过。（她怒气冲冲地走了出去）

Mike: She could have been talking about either one of us.
她可能正在谈论我们中的任何一个。

 

[Scene: Monica’s apartment. Somebody knocks the door]

Laura: Hi, I am Laura, I am here for your adoption interview.
你好，我是劳拉，我来这里参加你的收养面试。

Monica: Hi, I am Monica and this is Chandler.
大家好，我是莫妮卡，这是钱德勒。 Please come in.
请进来。

Laura: Thank you!
谢谢你！

Monica: Would you like something to drink?
你想喝点什么吗？

Laura: Oh, water would be fine.
哦，水就好了。

Monica: Ok.
好的。 Great.
伟大的。 I am so glad that you are here.
我很高兴你在这里。 We’re really excited about getting this process started.
我们对启动这个过程感到非常兴奋。

Chandler: Oh, because we love kids.
哦，因为我们爱孩子。 Love ‘em to death.
爱孩子爱得要死。Well, not actually to death, that's just a figure of speech - we love kids the appropriate amount...
当然，不是真的要死，只是打个比方——我们对孩子的爱很适度…… as allowed by law.
在法律允许的情况下。

Laura: Your place is just lovely.
你的地方真可爱。

Monica: Ah, thank you.
啊，谢谢你。 This building does have a wholesome family feel to it.
这座建筑确实有一种健康的家庭感觉。

Laura: You know, I...
你知道，我... I feel like I've been here before.
我感觉我以前来过这里。 Are any other couples in the
building adopting?
